meta.name: Campus Diaries
meta.description: Campus Diaries is a coming-of-age drama of six students at Excel University. But this one is so-not-your-regular-college-drama because it goes beyond the routine frolic and friendship plots that quintessential youth dramas portray and tackles relevant yet lesser discussed issues like ragging, discrimination based on societal biases, one sided love stories, rampant drug abuse and toxic relationships that mould your personality and ready you to face the real world.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: College begins and thus begins the welcome of all fresher students. Sanya, Sudheer, Abhilash and Sushmita get into trouble for ragging some students. They now have to face the dean. What will happen now? Will the dean give them a rather stern punishment?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sushmita, Sudheer and Abhilash get into yet another problem when they come to know that the course they failed in the previous semester has been discontinued. They are now on the quest of finding a professor who can teach them the same course again. On the other hand, Sanya insists Raghav take the same course as her so that they can spend some time together. Will Raghav agree to do so? Will Sushmita and others be successful in finding a professor?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sanya gets attracted to Raghav and decides to ask him out. To do so she gets him involved in a filmmaking competition. On the other hand, Sudheer and Abhilash step up to be good friends for Sushmita and try to get the camera back from her toxic ex-boyfriend, Aditya.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sushmita gets back with her ex, Aditya. This upsets Abhilash but he must focus on the task at hand- planting 100 trees overnight. Sudheer helps him in the same. Meanwhile, Raghav plans to ask out Chloe, but Sanya plots with Sushmita and stops him from doing so. Will they succeed? Will Abhilash be able to plant 100 trees in a night?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Sudheer wishes to command respect from the freshers and so organises a freshers’ party. Sanya continues trying to break Raghav and Chloe up with the help of Sushmita. Will she be successful in her plan? Find out in the Campus Diaries series episode.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sushmita gets stood up when Aditya cancels on her. Abhilash steps up and gets closer to Sushmita. Meanwhile, Sanya is left heartbroken. Sudheer freshers’ party also becomes a problem ground when the police show up, putting Sudheer in big trouble. How will Sudheer make his way out of this one?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, Adita takes Chloe, Raghav and Sushmita to a rave party as planned. On the other hand, Sanya realises that she has flunked in her lab test and has not been able to focus on her studies as much as she should have because of Raghav. She takes the decision to submerge herself in studies and thinks that this might also help her get over Raghav too. Meanwhile, Abhilash is in a bad mood and Sudhir thinks that the only way to cheer him now is to take him to a prostitute for an experience he has never had before. Will this cheer Sudhir up?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, a lot has changed since the beginning. Chloe and Raghav have broken uo their relationship because of the troubles that had been going on for a long time, while TA Nikhil and Sanya are busy working on Nikhil’s research together. On the other hand, Sushmita gets to know about Riya and Aditya’s relationship and she decides to confront them. Meanwhile, Sudhir is not the only one and he has an opposition now, Priyanka. Will this make it more difficult for him to win the elections?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, now that Sishir is not the only one standing for the position of Hostel Secretary in the elections, he realises that he is falling short of a lot of votes. This could mean that he can no longer achieve his dream of becoming the Hostel Secretary. Meanwhile, a new hell is waiting for Aditya when he realises that Sushmita had called his father and had a long talk. On the other hand, Sanya was having a good time with Nikhil and now she has a feeling that Nikhil might just be doing all this to sleep with her. Is this intuition or a huge misunderstanding?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, Sudhir now has to go all-in if he wants the title of the Hostel Secretary to be his. There is no way he can let his dream go just like that. But the challenges do not seem to end and now that Goldie has betrayed him and left, it has also cost him a lot of votes. What will he do now? On the other hand, Sanya and Nikhil finally reveal their feelings for each other and they begin to date each other. This was a long time coming. However, things have not been going great between Raghav and Chloe as they have a huge fight when she finds out that Raghav is smoking and lying to her. Where is this relationship going?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, the day has finally come for which every student in the college was waiting. It is finally Election day. All of Sudhir’s friends have now gathered for him to show support and to celebrate his win. Will he be able to win this post? On the other hand, Sushmita tells Abhilash that she is being blackmailed by Aditya. Meanwhile, Sanya gets accepted into IIT Mumbai. What has the future in stock for these children?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: In this episode of Campus diaries, everyone is on their way to begin the most important chapter of their lives. Chloe is leaving while Raghav gets to know that Sanya has liked him all this while. How will Raghav react to this information? He also gets to know that she is finally leaving for an internship in Mumbai and there will be a lot of distance between them. Sushmita and Abhilash finally disclose their feelings towards each other and they start dating. What does the future hold for all of them?

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Excel prepares to welcome alumnus Harshvardhan Shah as friendships, romance and campus chaos unfold, eventually winning him over.

videos.title: Denial
videos.overview: Sudheer struggles with feelings for Priyanka, while Sanya and Raghav face unresolved tension. Sushmita fights for herself and Abhilash falters.

videos.title: The Day After
videos.overview: Sanya and Raghav confront their feelings as Sudheer challenges council politics. Abhilash ends things with Shruti and reconnects with Sushmita.

videos.title: Make A Wish
videos.overview: Sanya and Raghav grow closer while she remains with Nikhil. Sushmita finds online success as fest politics and hidden jealousy intensify.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: Sanya faces a pregnancy scare, Sudheer reels from heartbreak, and Sushmita's influencer ambitions strain her relationship with Abhilash.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Sanya's health scare forces her to end things with Raghav, while Sushmita pursues influence and Priyanka and Sudheer fall for a fest scam.

videos.title: Irriversible
videos.overview: Sushmita's fame threatens her relationship with Abhilash. Sudheer's fest scam explodes, while Raghav spirals after losing Sanya.

videos.title: All Is Lost
videos.overview: Priyanka takes the fall for the fest scam, Abhilash and Sushmita drift apart and Raghav's actions destroy Sanya's relationship with Nikhil.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: The group faces painful breakups and consequences. Sanya and Raghav confront their feelings before Shruti is found unconscious in her hostel room.

videos.title: Black Day
videos.overview: Intimate videos of students are leaked and Shruti is blamed. Her friends uncover blackmail and decide to fight for the truth and justice.
